entities.summary: John Jacob Astor VIII, 3rd Baron Astor of Hever, is an English businessman and politician from the Astor family. He sat in the House of Lords as a Conservative hereditary peer from 1986 to his retirement in 2022. Astor was Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State at the Ministry of Defence from 2010 to 2015. Astor is a Deputy Lieutenant of Kent. John Astor, 3rd Baron Astor of Hever was a performers & entertainers from United Kingdom (b. 1946-06-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
